title: hub M2: Observer external_senders and GroupInfo tree accessors
description: Follow-ups from S3/M1: (1) an Observer (or wire GroupContext) accessor for the GroupContext external_senders extension, replacing S3's TEMPORARY tls_codec walk in hub/room.rs; (2) an accessor telling whether a wire::GroupInfo embeds a ratchet_tree extension, for create_room and S5 per H11 (.6.11). mimi-mls only. Oracle: mls-rs-built GroupInfos with/without the extension; hand-encoded external_senders.
